## "audited_by"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Username of a user or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
This is the username of the last person who audited the asset. Auditing will be done independently of the digitisation and usually by the technical team leader or a senior digitiser. Auditing an asset cannot be done by the same user that is the main digitiser.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
ARS when an asset is has its audit status set to "true".

**Updated where and when:**  
In ARS when a user audits an asset that had previously been audited.

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
audited_by

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
